text:
The most likely cause is **D. Salmonella typhi**, because Hektoen enteric agar is a selective and differential medium for Gram-negative enteric pathogens such as Salmonella and Shigella. C. difficile is not grown on this medium, so the positive culture argues against it despite the antibiotic history. The question's wording points to Salmonella, though antibiotic-associated diarrhea would also fit C. difficile.

CONFIDENCE: 70
